header.description: java.util.HashSet iteration order after every operation, recorded from the real JDK by tools/reference/JavaHashProbe.java; pins cyber_detectives.compat.javahash. orders_sha1_12[i] = first 12 hex digits of sha1(the keys after ops[i] joined by one space, 'null' for the null key).
header.op_syntax: '+K' = add(K), '-K' = remove(K); kind obj = distinct identity-hash objects named K, int = java.lang.Integer, str = java.lang.String; 'null' = the null key
